Lower Text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, by returning 2 [Vemmon] from one of your [Galacticmon]'s digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, switch the target of attack to this Digimon.
Upper Text: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the cost.

[On Play][When Digivolving] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon and Tamers so that their play cost total is up to 3 and delete them. For each [Vemmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 1 to the maximum play cost total this effect can choose.
